value.rationale: Completes sharp topological reversibility across all weighted trees, including arbitrary branches and weights outside source's diagonal dominance assumptions. Distinguishes a singular homeomorphism at equality from persistent robust multiple inverse branches for all greater coupling, with constructive proof valid for degenerate eigenvalues. The exact topology is a natural invariant of a physically motivated discrete phase map.
